atoms.sound: Hello, my name is Maya, and I’m a climate activist. I’ve been working with an environmental organisation for the last two years... Our main goal is to help people understand how their everyday choices affect the environment. For example, we organise clean-up events. Every month, volunteers meet at a local beach or park and collect waste.

b: ++a climate activist volunteering for an environmental organisation
a politician who cares about the environment
a student working on a school project about recycling

instruction.text: Höre dir Mayas Schilderungen an und beantworte anschließend die Fragen.

atoms.sound: Another important part of my work is protecting natural habitats by planting trees... Sometimes, we write to politicians and ask them to protect forests and endangered species with stronger laws. If forests continue to be destroyed, many animals will lose their habitats and some species could become extinct. Unfortunately, deforestation continues in order to create farmland and produce products such as palm oil.

instruction.text: Which of these environmental issues does Maya talk about? Choose all correct answers.
Höre dir Mayas Schilderungen an und beantworte anschließend die Fragen.

atoms.sound: I also try to live a more sustainable lifestyle. I use public transport whenever possible and I'm a vegetarian. Of course, one person alone cannot solve the climate crisis. But if millions of people make small changes, we can reduce carbon emissions and protect our planet for future generations.

instruction.text: Which of the following does Maya do to live more sustainably? Choose all correct answers.
Which statement best summarises Maya's opinion about climate protection?

b: ++Personal choices are important, especially when many people make them together.
Individual actions are pointless without government action.
Only people who eat meat are responsible for the climate crisis.
